component.name: Flare
component.summary: 2D animation studio with an Adobe Animate-like workflow

description.p: Flare is a community-driven fork of OpenToonz, redesigned to provide an Adobe Animate-like user interface and built-in import support for the Flash/Animate file family (FLA, XFL, SWF, SWC, FLV, F4V, AS).

It is based on OpenToonz (and Toonz, originally developed by Digital Video S.p.A. in Italy and customized by Studio Ghibli), adding a familiar workspace and Flash interoperability on top of the OpenToonz pipeline.
